generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a slender tree with a narrow crown, alternate oblong, finely toothed leaves and small clusters of white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 12 m tall and 22 cm across at breast height at 30 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green leaves; smooth, shiny reddish-brown bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: corymbs of bright red cherries about 1 cm across, a few still green. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white flowers in April and May; cherries red in July, gone by early September. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth reddish-brown bark with prominent horizontal lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
